decisions.reason: The Magento 2 template draws directly on the firm's shop-hosting know-how and serves its agency customers, but templates are minor, easily outdated items, and the firm already withdrew the similar responsive template, so a withdrawal is fairly likely even though keeping it costs little.
Premium support extends the firm's core round-the-clock expert support and its agency-focused service promise, so it fits existing capabilities and customer feedback is easy to interpret and act on.

Scalable agency hosting is the firm's flagship, sits at the centre of its hosting and data-center knowledge, and benefits directly from its own R&D, so it is the product the firm learns from and improves most readily.
